what: Five Written-on-the-Wall-II (Graffiti.pc, DeLaViña) conjectures — 353, 360, 373 (trees, total domination; 18 Feb 2009) and 395b, 396 (connected graphs, 2-domination; Jan 2010), all listed open in the archive — and the explicit counterexamples posted against them on google-deepmind/formal-conjectures on 2026-10-14 by RhudeJJJJ (self-identified Jonas J. Gebendorfer; OpenAI Codex assistance stated), as issues #7304, #7305, #7306, #7308, #7330 and PRs #7310, #7321, #7322, #7320, #7337 (each `sorry`, tagged research solved, formal_proof linking the author's fork).

claims.353: a 25-vertex tree with gamma_t = 10 < c(T[D_2]) + k_M/2 = 9 + 3/2
claims.360: a 41-vertex tree with gamma_t = 6 < c(T[S u L]) + dist_avg(C,V)/2 = 4 + 321/160
claims.396: a 39-vertex connected graph (K4..K9 + five bridges) with gamma_2 = 12 > dd_mode + |M| + |E(A_3, V - A_3)| = 2 + 8 + 0
claims.395b: a 15-vertex connected graph (K4, K5, K6 + seven bridges) with gamma_2 = 6 > |M| + delta(G[V - A]) + |V - A_3| = 4 + 1 + 0

definitions: the archive's (corpus/wowii/sources/archive: open.html snapshots 2010-07-17 and 2016-10-09, wowIIdefs.js): definition 94 total domination, 90 2-domination (members exempt), 38 and 95 the averages over positive distances with denominator |S|(n-1), 45 the modes and dd_mode, 56 minimum degree, 112 edges between two sets. The Lean statements of the PRs are read against these and any difference named (the 395b nonemptiness hypothesis; dd_mode on a unique mode).
graphs: built from the witness tables of the claimant's Lean proofs (fork/*.lean, read as text) and checked against the issues' prose counts (vertices, edges); the 395b graph exists only in the Lean.
deciders: instruments/wowii/decide.py, standard library: gamma_t by an exact tree DP, sandwiched by an explicit total dominating set and vertices with pairwise disjoint open neighbourhoods; gamma_2 by exhaustion (2^15) or by the private-vertex argument (each clique keeps two vertices with no outside neighbour) met by an explicit set; components, eccentricities, centres, periphery, degree modes and averages as Fractions.
rules: No claimant code or Lean is executed or built; the fork files are data.
The record (certs/wowii-ledger.json) is committed before any comparison with the author's prose values is written up.
A row is CERTIFIED iff the graph is as described (tree / connected, the stated order) and the archive's inequality fails on it by exact arithmetic; REFUTED iff it holds.
Controls: the tree DP must equal brute force on small random trees; the deciders must reproduce the author's stated side values exactly.
redControls: a tree where the DP must equal brute force
a set that is not total dominating is not accepted as an upper certificate
vertices whose open neighbourhoods meet are not accepted as a lower certificate
the 395b graph with one bridge removed is disconnected and refused
the 360 right side computed with the half dropped still exceeds the left
